title: 20th Presentable Course
subtitle: Beyond the Uniform
motto: The Journey. The Bond. The Mission.
description: A three-day reunion marking ten years of service, friendship and purpose for the 20th Presentable Course of the Nigeria Immigration Service. Join us for a symposium, outdoor team activities and an anniversary dinner with recognition and a bonfire night.
